name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
title: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd - 542726 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Paying suppliers fell 1,200 in Q4 as Silver churn rose to ~7% monthly and gross adds slowed; growth now rests almost entirely on ARPU (8-9%) with customer growth only 1-2%.

triggers.label: Silver monthly churn ~7%, up from 5-6%
triggers.quote: Monthly side used to be 5% to 6%. Now we are running at 7%, about 2% per month we have deteriorated.

triggers.label: Paying suppliers down 1,200 in Q4
triggers.quote: the quarter 4 saw a little decline of 1,200. This decrease can primarily be attributed to moderation in gross addition

triggers.label: Not reversing price hike despite churn
triggers.quote: but we are not going back on pricing

triggers.label: No net-add guidance; double-digit growth aim
triggers.quote: So we'll continue to have no guidance on the net adds until we have multiple quarters of continual success.

guidance.value: No guidance until multiple quarters of success
guidance.quote: So we'll continue to have no guidance on the net adds until we have multiple quarters of continual success.
So we'll continue to aim for a double -digit growth in the near term.

red_flags.label: Silver churn elevated; supplier count declining
red_flags.quote: Now we are running at 7%, about 2% per month we have deteriorated.

red_flags.label: Customer growth 1-2%, growth driven by ARPU
red_flags.quote: Currently, since the customer growth is hardly 1 - 2%, so most of the growth is coming from ARPU which is growing at 8 - 9%.

red_flags.label: Unique buyers down, active buyers down 3% YoY
red_flags.quote: Registered buyers is up 9% Y-on-Y and active buyers is actually down 3% Y -on-Y.

red_flags.label: Other income negative on bond MTM
red_flags.quote: Consolidated Other income for the quarter stood at negative Rs. 34 crores.

evasions.quote: I don't think I would be able to give you that number because performance marketing is very new
I've already answered that question in the previous response.
